title: Quality
text: Quality. Was very cheaply made.will return.  I bought one of the most expensive. The top of the sugar glass was so chinsy. I was afraid to open the tab.  It would bend and fall off. I found one at home goods,stainless steel top, perfect  $3.99.  will return the two shortly.
